ceu: ✦ The trine between Venus and Uranus

s.k: Curiosity switched on: ask, listen, learn.
t: With the Moon in your house of communication, a word said at the right moment can clear up a misunderstanding.

The trine between Venus and Uranus brings together, in your favour, relationships and conversations: Venus brings affection and harmony, Uranus brings surprises and the urge to change. Use it to take a step you keep putting off.
s.d: Learn a new word or a new thing today, out of curiosity.

s.k: A day to sort out what really matters to you.
t: The Moon lights up what you have and what you are worth. A day to value your work and your time.

The trine between Venus and Uranus brings together, in your favour, routine and money: Venus brings affection and harmony, Uranus brings surprises and the urge to change. Accept whatever help comes along, wherever it comes from.
s.d: Cook a meal you love at home and savour it slowly.

s.k: Your presence speaks for itself today.
t: Your sign welcomes the Moon and your mood may swing more than usual. Give yourself time and do not take everything to heart.

The trine between Venus and Uranus brings together, in your favour, romance and your image: Venus brings affection and harmony, Uranus brings surprises and the urge to change. It is a good moment to bring the two together in a single plan.
s.d: Keep away from people who drain your energy, even if only for a day.

t: The Moon passes through your most private area and asks for retreat. Slowing down today is not wasting time.

The trine between Venus and Uranus brings together, in your favour, family and your inner life: Venus brings affection and harmony, Uranus brings surprises and the urge to change. Use this good energy to sort out what had stalled.
s.d: Write down last night's dreams as soon as you wake up.

s.k: The right friends make all the difference.
t: Today a group, an association or a friend may bring you a new idea. Stay open.

The trine between Venus and Uranus brings together, in your favour, conversations and friendships: Venus brings affection and harmony, Uranus brings surprises and the urge to change. Doors open more easily when you ask clearly.
s.d: Step away from a group that only brings you down.

s.k: A day to show what you are worth.
t: With the Moon at the highest point of your sky, it is a good day for career decisions with both feet on the ground.

The trine between Venus and Uranus brings together, in your favour, money and your career: Venus brings affection and harmony, Uranus brings surprises and the urge to change. An idea from today could become a real project.
s.d: Thank those who helped you get where you are.

s.k: Faith in the path opens the path.
t: The Moon widens your vision. What looked like a problem today may turn into a lesson.

The trine between Venus and Uranus brings together, in your favour, your image and your horizons: Venus brings affection and harmony, Uranus brings surprises and the urge to change. Trust what you are building: today the sky lends a hand.
s.d: Look up a place you would like to visit.

s.k: What runs deep asks for truth.
t: It is a day of quiet transformation. What ends today leaves room for something truer.

The trine between Venus and Uranus brings together, in your favour, your inner life and intimacy: Venus brings affection and harmony, Uranus brings surprises and the urge to change. Smile more: kindness opens paths today.
s.d: Forgive someone in your heart, even without telling them.

s.k: Together you go further than alone.
t: The Moon passes through your opposite sign and puts other people at the centre of the day. Today listening is worth more than talking.

The trine between Venus and Uranus brings together, in your favour, friendships and relationships: Venus brings affection and harmony, Uranus brings surprises and the urge to change. A small gesture can have a big effect today.
s.d: Suggest a plan for the two of you this week.

s.k: Your body is asking for attention: listen to it.
t: Today your body speaks louder. Drink water, take breaks and do not ignore tiredness.

The trine between Venus and Uranus brings together, in your favour, your career and routine: Venus brings affection and harmony, Uranus brings surprises and the urge to change. Be thankful for what goes well and say it out loud.
s.d: Help a colleague with something small: it comes back to you twice over.

s.k: Let joy in without asking permission.
t: With the Moon in your house of joy, creativity flows. Give shape to an idea you have been keeping to yourself.

The trine between Venus and Uranus brings together, in your favour, your horizons and romance: Venus brings affection and harmony, Uranus brings surprises and the urge to change. Let things flow without forcing them.
s.d: Surprise someone you love, even if it is just a note.

t: Family and home take priority. A simple gesture of care has a very big effect today.

The trine between Venus and Uranus brings together, in your favour, intimacy and family: Venus brings affection and harmony, Uranus brings surprises and the urge to change. Put your heart and your head on the same side.
s.d: Make a family recipe and share it.
